_help: Economy v2 (2026-10-20, DESIGN §21): zombie drops are rarer (drop_chance 0.14 -> 0.08, gear weight 5 -> 4 of the entries, rarity weights shifted toward common, smaller per-round bonus); chests now cost points and relocate instead of re-arming each round (data/economy.json -> chests), so their table is unchanged. Loot tables. Each table: drop_chance (0-1, per kill/open), rolls, weighted 'entries' and 'rarity_weights'. Entry kinds: gear (random weapon or armor), weapon (optional archetype/slot), armor (optional slot), consumable (id = file in resources/items). 'rarity_round_bonus' adds weight per round survived.

stash._help: Persistent stash (Skillz). cap = max spare (non-equipped) gear pieces carried between matches, across all 8 slots, on top of each slot's 9-tile grid. Equipped gear does not count. Scrap (right-click) frees space. Saved in progress.cfg [stash].

item_power._help: Diablo-style Item Power. Each drop rolls base + per_round*(round-1) + rarity_bonus +/- variance (capped at max). Item power scales the item: weapon damage x(1 + (IP-100)*damage_per_point); every rolled weapon stat EXCEPT those in ip_stat_exclude gets +(IP-100)*stat_points_per_point; armor stat totals get +(IP-100)*armor_points_per_point. Impact is excluded so damage_per_point is the only Item Power damage dial (IP 400 = exactly 2.2x).
item_power._upgrade_margin_help: GearDB.is_upgrade (loot '!' badge, G4M3N markers): a piece is an upgrade when its effective Item Power beats the equipped one by at least upgrade_margin (more than variance, so same-round same-rarity rolls are not flagged), or matches it at a higher rarity.

roll_quality._help: Roll quality (0-1) = how far through the random roll range an item's stats landed for its Item Power and rarity (0 = worst possible roll, 1 = best). Weapons: weighted average over stats of (random offset + stat_variance) / (2 * stat_variance), measured after the 1..100 clamp. Armor: position of the random total inside armor.json piece_totals for its rarity. Stored on the item and saved; items saved without it get it derived from their stats on load (derive_missing), otherwise legacy_default.

grenade_drops._help: Grenade drops (MAIN_HOOKS §24c, Skillz). A loot-table entry {kind: grenade} picks a grenades.json id by drop_weight (frag 100, pulse 60, uncommon 30, rare 12, legendary 4, mythic 1) x rarity_mult[its rarity]. rarity_mult is Economy v2's rarer-drops scaling: the new / old gear rarity weights (58/50, 29/32, 10.5/14, 2.2/3.5, 0.3/0.5), so a Mythic grenade is 0.6x as likely as before relative weights. Effective odds: frag 44%, Tremor 26%, each uncommon 10%, each rare 3.4%, each legendary 1%, Requiem Bell 0.2%. Zombie table: weight 1 of 12 at drop_chance 0.08 = 0.67% of kills; chest: weight 1 of 11 per roll. Picking one up (E) replaces your grenade for the rest of the match (the player.gd §24c hunk keeps it through apply_stats).
